idea-plugin.name: Parquet Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Parquet Viewer is a lightweight and efficient IntelliJ IDEA plugin that allows you to open and explore .parquet files directly within the IDE — no external tools required.

Features:
  • Schema view — instantly inspect the full schema in a readable format.
  • Data preview — view actual rows in a table with pagination support.
  • Column selector — hide irrelevant fields to improve performance and readability.
  • Column and data filters — quickly find what you need, with regex and condition-based filters.
  • Export to CSV or JSON — extract your filtered results for external use.
  • Drag-and-drop support — just drop a .parquet file into the plugin to open it.
  • Built-in dark mode compatibility — clean, adaptive UI for all themes.
Use Cases:
  • Inspect Parquet files in big data, Spark, or Hadoop projects
  • Quickly inspect and analyze a single Parquet file directly within IntelliJ.
  • Built-in pagination, column filtering, and CSV export for efficient single-file data exploration.
License:

Apache 2.0
